patches_added.name: Fix login
patches_added.description: Fixes the "This app version/OS is not currently supported" error that blocks login after the app has been patched. Twitch runs a Play Integrity check in the background and reports the result to its login server; re-signing makes that check fail, so the server refuses the login. This stops the app from sending that attestation, so it looks like a device without Google Play, where login works normally. It does not change anything else about how you log in.
